summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend e2e testing of GCSMART. Seeded student + teacher sessions in Mongo. Ran 15 pytest cases (all pass) and Playwright flows through the preview URL: dashboard, theme toggle, Study Center (Video Lessons dialog + iframe, Past Questions -> real-AI exam -> submit/next/finish -> results screen), AI Tutor SSE streaming, Analytics recharts, Settings persistence, Teacher Portal new-lesson creation. Everything works end-to-end against real AI (openai gpt-5.4) and MongoDB.

issues: Recharts logs 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' warnings during initial paint (containers momentarily 0). Charts render correctly; consider setting explicit min-height on ResponsiveContainer parents to silence noise.
Radix DialogContent is missing aria-describedby / Description — a11y warning. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby={undefined} suppressor.

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription to video-lesson and new-lesson Dialogs to remove a11y warning.
(Optional) Fix Recharts width/height(-1) warnings by ensuring parent containers have a min-height when rendered inside grids.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_current_user: OK — includes Bearer fallback + expiry check + _id exclusion.

questions/generate: cache key includes level|subject|year|paper|count and is stored idempotently — good, but there's no TTL or invalidation; cached AI content lives forever. Consider expiring after 30-60 days to allow curriculum refresh.
ai/chat: line 411 `await chat.get_messages` is a dead no-op reference (accesses attribute without calling); safe to delete — replace with real history push if intended.
courses view: idempotent per (course_id, student_id) is correct — earnings only credited once per unique student.
seed endpoint requires auth (Depends chain via user in get_current_user) — actually /api/seed has no auth dependency; this is intentional but consider gating in production to avoid arbitrary seeding.
server.py is a single 596-line file — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into routers (auth, exam, ai, teacher) soon.
seed_data_creation: Seeded users user_teststudent01 (student) and user_testteacher01 (teacher) with 7-day sessions test_session_student_01 / test_session_teacher_01 via mongosh. POST /api/seed created 3 demo lesson videos owned by demo.teacher@gcsmart.cm. Tests created a few TEST_ prefixed courses, one attempt, cached MCQs for GCE O Level Mathematics 2023 (count=3 and count=5).
test_credentials: Student session_token=test_session_student_01 (user_teststudent01), Teacher session_token=test_session_teacher_01 (user_testteacher01). Cookie domain: cameroon-study-hub.preview.emergentagent.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints validated in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Reuse those tests as regression. Cache is warm for GCE O Level Mathematics 2023 paper 1 (counts 3 and 5) — start-exam finishes almost instantly for those settings, use them to avoid 10-40s AI wait. For teacher flow, use test_session_teacher_01 cookie and the 'new-lesson-btn' modal.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional defects observed. Only minor console warnings (Recharts sizing during first paint and Radix Dialog a11y description missing).
